Supabase JavaScript client 2.119.0, MIT license.

Bundled UMD distribution from the published npm package:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0/dist/umd/supabase.js

Version is pinned and served locally. The application loads it only for cloud
